wikipedia.extract: The red-tailed monkey (Cercopithecus ascanius), also known as the black-cheeked white-nosed monkey, red-tailed guenon, redtail monkey, or Schmidt's guenon, is a species of primate in the family Cercopithecidae. It is found in Angola, Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, and possibly Burundi.
wikipedia.title: Red-tailed monkey

commonNames.name: Blue-eyed Black Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The blue-eyed black lemur (Eulemur flavifrons), also known as the Sclater's lemur, is a species of true lemur. It can attain a body length of 39–45 cm (15–18 in), a tail length of 51–65 cm (20–26 in), a total length of 90–100 cm (35–39 in), and a weight of 1.8–1.9 kg (4.0–4.2 lb).
wikipedia.title: Blue-eyed black lemur

wikipedia.extract: The common raven or northern raven (Corvus corax) is a large all-black passerine bird. It is the most widely distributed of all corvids, found across the Northern Hemisphere.
wikipedia.title: Common raven

wikipedia.extract: Pulsatrix is a genus of owl in the family Strigidae. They are called spectacled owls because of their prominent facial pattern.
wikipedia.title: Pulsatrix

wikipedia.extract: Todus is a genus of birds found in the Caribbean. It is the only genus within the todies family Todidae.
wikipedia.title: Todus

wikipedia.extract: Psittacus (African grey parrots) is a genus of parrots in the subfamily Psittacinae. It contains two species, the grey parrot (Psittacus erithacus) and the Timneh parrot (Psittacus timneh).
wikipedia.title: Psittacus

commonNames.name: Tonkean Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Tonkean black macaque or Tonkean macaque (Macaca tonkeana) is a species of primate in the family Cercopithecidae. It is endemic to central Sulawesi and the nearby Togian Islands in Indonesia.
wikipedia.title: Tonkean macaque

commonNames.name: Barred Owl
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The barred owl (Strix varia), also known as the northern barred owl, striped owl or, more informally, hoot owl or eight hooter, is a North American large species of owl. A member of the true owl family, Strigidae, they belong to the genus Strix, which is also the origin of the family's name under Linnaean taxonomy.
wikipedia.title: Barred owl

wikipedia.extract: Brown doves are members of the genus Phapitreron in the pigeon family. Their common name refers to their overall brown coloration.
wikipedia.title: Brown dove

wikipedia.extract: Cormobates is a genus of bird in the Australasian treecreeper family. Its scientific name means ‘trunk-creeper’, from the Greek cormos (κορµός, ‘tree trunk’) and bates (βάτης, ‘one who treads’).
wikipedia.title: Cormobates

wikipedia.extract: Cnidaria ( nih-DAIR-ee-ə, ny-) is a phylum of animals containing over 11,000 species of aquatic invertebrates found both in freshwater and marine environments (predominantly the latter), including jellyfish, hydroids, sea anemones, corals and some of the smallest marine parasites. Their distinguishing features are a decentralized nerve net distributed throughout a gelatinous body, and the presence of cnidocytes or cnidoblasts, specialized cells with ejectable organelles used mainly for envenomation and capturing prey.
wikipedia.title: Cnidaria

wikipedia.extract: The Anatidae are the biological family of water birds that includes ducks, geese, and swans. The family has a cosmopolitan distribution, occurring on all the world's continents except Antarctica.
wikipedia.title: Anatidae

wikipedia.extract: Polyboroides is a genus of bird of prey in the family Accipitridae. This genus has two recognized species found in Sub-Saharan Africa and Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Polyboroides

commonNames.name: Platypus
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The platypus (Ornithorhynchus anatinus), sometimes referred to as the duck-billed platypus, is a semiaquatic, egg-laying mammal endemic to eastern Australia, including Tasmania. The platypus is the sole living representative of the family Ornithorhynchidae and genus Ornithorhynchus, though a number of related species appear in the fossil record.
wikipedia.title: Platypus

wikipedia.extract: Nystalus is a genus of puffbirds in the family Bucconidae. The genus Nystalus was introduced in 1863 by the German ornithologists Jean Cabanis and Ferdinand Heine.
wikipedia.title: Nystalus

wikipedia.extract: Nesotrochis is a genus of extinct flightless birds that were endemic to the islands of the Greater Antilles in the Caribbean. They have often been called cave rails, though they are no longer considered true rails, but an independent lineage of gruiform birds.
wikipedia.title: Nesotrochis

wikipedia.extract: The gold-and-white marmoset (Mico chrysoleucos), also known as the golden-white tassel-ear marmoset, is a species of marmoset, a small monkey endemic to the Amazon rainforest in eastern Amazonas state, Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Gold-and-white marmoset

commonNames.name: Nepal Gray Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Nepal gray langur (Semnopithecus schistaceus) is a gray langur endemic to the Himalayas in Nepal, far southwestern Tibet, northern India, northern Pakistan, Bhutan and possibly Afghanistan. It is found in forests at an elevation of 1,500 to 4,000 metres (4,900 to 13,100 ft).
wikipedia.title: Nepal gray langur

wikipedia.extract: Paranthropus boisei is a species of australopithecine from the Early Pleistocene of East Africa about 2.5 to 1.15 million years ago. The holotype specimen, OH 5, was discovered by palaeoanthropologist Mary Leakey in 1959 at Olduvai Gorge, Tanzania and described by her husband Louis a month later.
wikipedia.title: Paranthropus boisei

wikipedia.extract: Phoeniconaias is a genus of birds in the flamingo family Phoenicopteridae. The genus contains one extant species, the lesser flamingo (Phoeniconaias minor), occurring in sub-Saharan Africa and western India, and an extinct species, Phoeniconaias proeses, from the Pliocene of Australia, which is thought to have been even smaller.
wikipedia.title: Phoeniconaias

commonNames.name: Kenya Coast Galago
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Kenya coast galago (Paragalago cocos) is a species of primate in the family Galagidae. It is found across Kenya and Tanzania, particularly around the northern coastal area of each of the countries, and has been located living from sea level to around 350 metres (1,150 ft) above sea level.
wikipedia.title: Kenya coast galago
